name: Milvus
summary: Open-source vector database, release line 3.0 (v3.0.5): Lite/Standalone/Distributed deployment, schema and field types, vector/sparse/scalar indexes, BM25 full text search, analyzers, text/phrase match, highlighter, hybrid search and rerankers (RRF, weighted, boost, decay, model), embedding functions, multi-tenancy, admin/config reference, PyMilvus 3.0.2 SDK reference, RESTful API reference, Milvus Lite 3.2.2 README and design notes, release notes.
license: Apache-2.0 (milvus-docs, web-content, milvus-lite and pymilvus repositories)

sources.url: https://github.com/milvus-io/pymilvus/releases (v3.0.0, v3.0.1, v3.0.2, via gh release view)
https://github.com/milvus-io/milvus-lite/releases (v3.0.0 to v3.2.2, via gh release view)

coverage: All English Milvus 3.0.x docs as served on milvus.io/docs (about, get started and install for Lite/Standalone/Distributed/GPU, user guide: collections, schema and field types, analyzers/tokenizers/filters, indexes, insert/delete, search/query incl. full text search, text match, phrase match, highlighter, hybrid search, search aggregation; embedding functions and rerankers; admin guide; system configuration reference; architecture; FAQ; tutorials; integrations; AI tools), Milvus server release notes v3.0-beta to v3.0.5 (docs/release_notes.md), the full PyMilvus 3.0.x API reference (MilvusClient, ORM, EmbeddingModels, Rerankers, DataImport, FileResource), the Milvus RESTful API v1/v2 reference for 3.0.x (converted to Markdown), the Milvus Lite v3.2.2 README and design notes, and PyMilvus 3.0.x and Milvus Lite 3.x release notes.
gaps: Node.js, Go, Java, C#, C++ and Rust SDK references are not included (they exist in milvus-io/web-content for v3.0.x); only PyMilvus and RESTful
The docs repo is versioned per branch (v3.0.x), not tagged per patch release; taken from the branch head. The API references come from the master branch of web-content (folder v3.0.x)
Milvus server GitHub release pages were not saved separately; the docs' own release_notes.md covers v3.0-beta to v3.0.5
Milvus 2.6.x docs (still maintained, latest 2.6.26) are not included
Zilliz Cloud docs, the Milvus blog and the bootcamp notebooks (linked from tutorials) are not included
Images were never in the source Markdown (it links to images on S3); those links stay and will not resolve offline
RESTful reference pages were converted from MDX (embedded OpenAPI operation JSON) into Markdown; no single OpenAPI spec file is published for 3.0.x, so there is no api/ folder
Milvus Lite design notes (content/milvus-lite/docs/) are developer design documents and some sections describe planned work; the README is the authoritative feature list
Milvus Lite docs/superpowers/ (AI-agent planning files) were not included
notes: Latest stable Milvus release resolved from GitHub releases: v3.0.5 (2026-10-30); 2.6.26 is a maintenance line. milvus.io publishes docs per minor line (v3.0.x branch of milvus-io/milvus-docs; version.json says released), so the folder is '3.0'. The docs site's {{var.*}} placeholders were substituted from site/en/Variables.json on that branch: milvus_release_version/milvus_release_tag/milvus_image=3.0.5, milvus_python_sdk_version=3.0.x, milvus_python_sdk_real_version=3.0.2, milvus_lite_version=3.2.2, milvus_node_sdk_real_version=3.0.6, milvus_java_sdk_real_version=3.0.12, milvus_go_sdk_real_version=3.0.0, milvus_operator_version=1.3.7, milvus_helm_chart_version=5.0.22, woodpecker_release_version=0.1.46, milvus_backup_release=0.5.16, product_name=Milvus, example_endpoint=http://localhost:19530, example_token=root:Milvus (and the rest of that file). {{fragments/NAME.md}} includes were replaced with the text of site/en/fragments/NAME.md (the fragments folder is kept). {{tab}} lines (a version/method tab-bar UI marker) were removed. Remaining {{...}} are user-fill placeholders in commands ({{coords_ip}}, {{query}}) or the unused fragments/tail.md. Removed non-doc files: Variables.json, menuStructure/en.json (sidebar), home/home.json (landing-page cards). RESTful MDX pages were converted to Markdown with a one-off script: the embedded `specs` JSON was rendered as parameters/request/response lists, x-i18n (zh-CN/ja-JP translations) and x-added-at bookkeeping keys dropped, and <include target="milvus"> kept while <include target="zilliz"> was removed. One RESTful page (v2/Import (v2)/Get Progress.md) has an upstream Chinese response description ('成功' = success). Downloaded docs contain example LLM prompts in RAG code and 'Full prompt' sections in aiTools/ meant to be pasted into coding assistants; these are content, not instructions.
